cards.definition: Correct and exact, with no mistakes.
cards.example: She gave an accurate description of the lost dog.

cards.definition: Something done successfully through effort.
cards.example: Finishing the marathon was a huge achievement for him.

cards.definition: Very old; from a long time ago.
cards.example: The museum has an ancient vase from Egypt.

cards.definition: To say something publicly so others know.
cards.example: The teacher will announce the winners after lunch.

cards.definition: Suitable or correct for a situation.
cards.example: It is not appropriate to shout in the library.

cards.definition: To put things in a certain order or position.
cards.example: Please arrange the books by color on the shelf.

cards.definition: Usual or typical; not unusually large or small.
cards.example: The average temperature in June is quite warm.

cards.definition: A line that marks the edge of an area.
cards.example: The fence marks the boundary of our backyard.

cards.definition: Careful to avoid danger or mistakes.
cards.example: Be cautious when crossing the busy street.

cards.definition: To fall down or break apart suddenly.
cards.example: The old bridge began to collapse during the storm.

cards.definition: To share information, thoughts, or feelings.
cards.example: We communicate with our pen pals by writing letters.

cards.definition: Large in size or amount.
cards.example: It took a considerable amount of time to build the model.

cards.definition: Brave; not afraid to face danger or difficulty.
cards.example: The firefighter was courageous when she ran into the smoke.

cards.definition: Eager to learn or know more about something.
cards.example: The curious kitten poked its head into every box.

cards.definition: Easily broken or damaged; fine and fragile.
cards.example: Handle the glass ornament gently because it is delicate.

cards.definition: To decide something firmly, or to find out for certain.
cards.example: Scientists will determine the cause of the disease.

cards.definition: Sleepy and tired.
cards.example: After lunch, the warm sun made him feel drowsy.

cards.definition: Wanting very much to do or have something.
cards.example: She was eager to open her birthday presents.

cards.definition: Very, very large in size or amount.
cards.example: The blue whale is an enormous animal.

cards.definition: Absolutely necessary; very important.
cards.example: Water is essential for all living things.

cards.definition: To look at something closely and carefully.
cards.example: The doctor will examine your arm to check the bone.

cards.definition: Extremely tired.
cards.example: After the long hike, the hikers were exhausted.

cards.definition: Easily broken or damaged.
cards.example: Mark the box 'fragile' because it has dishes inside.

cards.definition: Happening often.
cards.example: There were frequent thunderstorms during the rainy season.

cards.definition: Extremely angry.
cards.example: He was furious when someone scratched his new bike.

cards.definition: Willing to give or share freely.
cards.example: It was generous of her to share her lunch with a friend.

cards.definition: Real and true; not fake.
cards.example: Her smile showed genuine happiness.

cards.definition: Extremely large; giant-sized.
cards.example: A gigantic sandcastle appeared on the beach.

cards.definition: To pause before doing or saying something, often because of doubt.
cards.example: Don't hesitate to ask if you need help.

cards.definition: Exactly the same.
cards.example: The twins wore identical red shirts.

cards.definition: To make or become better.
cards.example: Practicing every day will improve your free throws.

cards.definition: To ask for information.
cards.example: She decided to inquire about the missing package.

cards.definition: Set apart or alone, away from others.
cards.example: The cabin was isolated, miles from the nearest town.

cards.definition: Extremely beautiful or impressive.
cards.example: The sunset over the ocean was magnificent.

cards.definition: Difficult to understand or explain; strange.
cards.example: A mysterious noise came from the attic at night.

cards.definition: Needed in order for something to happen.
cards.example: A helmet is necessary when riding a bike.

cards.definition: Easy to see or understand; clear.
cards.example: It was obvious that the cat wanted more food.

cards.definition: A particular time or event.
cards.example: We wore nice clothes for the special occasion.

cards.definition: To successfully deal with or defeat a problem.
cards.example: She worked hard to overcome her fear of swimming.

cards.definition: Specific; relating to one certain thing and not others.
cards.example: This particular recipe needs extra sugar.

cards.definition: Lasting forever or for a very long time.
cards.example: The artist made a permanent mark with the dark ink.

cards.definition: To convince someone to do or believe something.
cards.example: He tried to persuade his sister to share her toys.

cards.definition: Coming before in time; earlier.
cards.example: Our previous teacher moved to a different school.

cards.definition: Happening very quickly.
cards.example: The river had a rapid current after the rain.

cards.definition: Not willing to do something; hesitant.
cards.example: She was reluctant to try the spicy soup.

cards.definition: Worthy of attention; extraordinary.
cards.example: The gymnast made a remarkable recovery from her injury.

cards.definition: To look like or be similar to something.
cards.example: That cloud seems to resemble a dragon.

cards.definition: To make something known or visible that was hidden.
cards.example: The magician will reveal his trick at the end.

cards.definition: Relating to the countryside, rather than a city.
cards.example: They moved from the city to a rural farm.

cards.definition: Not enough of something; rare.
cards.example: Fresh water can be scarce during a drought.

cards.definition: Honest and truly meant, without pretending.
cards.example: He gave a sincere apology for breaking the vase.

cards.definition: Refusing to change your mind or give up.
cards.example: The stubborn mule wouldn't move from the path.

cards.definition: Enough for a particular purpose.
cards.example: We had sufficient supplies for the camping trip.

cards.definition: Feeling that something is wrong or untrustworthy.
cards.example: The dog gave a suspicious growl at the stranger.

cards.definition: Very great in size, amount, or degree.
cards.example: The team celebrated a tremendous victory.

cards.definition: Being the only one of its kind; special.
cards.example: Every snowflake has a unique pattern.

cards.definition: Relating to a city or town.
cards.example: Tall buildings are common in urban areas.

cards.definition: To disappear suddenly and completely.
cards.example: The fog made the mountain seem to vanish.

cards.definition: Extremely large in area or amount.
cards.example: The desert stretched out in a vast sea of sand.

cards.definition: Producing strong, clear images in the mind; bright.
cards.example: She had a vivid dream about flying over the ocean.
